text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- At a protest rally the opposition IMRO-DPMNY demanded the government's resignation and early elections. A memorandum with these demands was submitted to the parliament administration.
- Macedonian defence minister Blagoja Handziski touring borderposts Strezovo and Radlka towards the Albanian border says Macedonia faces a large influx of refugees.
- International military exercises Rescuer 97 within the scope of NATO's Partnership for Peace programme ended at the Krivolak military base in central Macedonia.

- Macedonian President Kiro Gligorov is the only Balkan leader, with the exception of leaders of the Federal Republic of Yugoslavia who has not yet visited the White House. Would the first Gligorov-Clinton meeting eliminate last American reserves towards the issue of Macedonia's name, paper says in commentary on Gligorov's June 17 visit to the U.S.
- Around 30,000 people voice dissatisfaction with the government in central Skopje on Thursday evening at a rally organised by VMRO-DPMNE.
- Several Macedonian army officers to participate in NATO military exercises in Bulgaria. -- Mircela Casule, Skopje newsroom +389 91 201 196
